summary.prose: Implement and prove pre-read live-store exclusion in shared grep, then validate compatibility and record evidence. Canonical store-containing roots use the guarded Node walker; ordinary roots retain explicitly non-following ripgrep. No public API or persistent-model change.

tasks.title: Guard shared grep admission and prove store read exclusion
tasks.summary: Implement approved canonical, component-safe root ancestry decision for both data and lock targets before either rg branch. Refuse direct protected roots, reuse guarded Node for containing roots, and enforce --no-config/--no-follow on rg elsewhere. Add isolated read/spawn instrumentation and alias/allowed controls without changing public APIs or generic file policy.
acceptanceChecks: Direct protected roots and symlink aliases refuse before any backend spawn or protected content read.
Containing roots and directory aliases choose Node before rg spawn in bounded and complete modes; data and lock targets are checked independently and Node skips protected content reads.
Ordinary roots keep real rg, ignore ambient config and do not follow nested symlinks; allowed same-name files and component-prefix siblings remain searchable.
usedRipgrep, excludedByRule, limits and failures accurately describe actual execution; no output-only filtering, new public options or storage/IPC shape changes.
Instrument content reads and backend spawn in isolated fixtures; explicitly cover independently resolved lock target, canonical-prefix collision and aliases.

tests.name: Protected direct roots refuse before backend or content access
Store ancestor and directory aliases use guarded Node in bounded and complete modes
Allowed roots retain real ripgrep without ambient configuration or symlink following

tasks.title: Validate shared search compatibility and record Batch 03 evidence
tasks.summary: Run focused serial safety and existing search/file/analyzer regressions under supported Node22 with clean owned output. Preserve complete-mode partial-failure semantics and report any existing startup timing failure distinctly; update audit and batch status with actual counts, closure evidence and limits.
acceptanceChecks: ac1–ac4 have recorded focused test evidence, including original leak reproduction, protected read absence and allowed matches.
Root typecheck and relevant focused checks are run with actual pass/fail/skip/cancel counts, runtime/backend details and confirmed cleanup; no overlapping broad sweep.
Complete-mode timeout/exit failures preserve allowed partial hits; unchanged baseline 300ms fake-rg startup failure remains reported rather than skipped, disguised or fixed by enlarging deadlines.
Document Node semantics for store-ancestor searches, existing path replacement/hardlink limits, unchanged public contract and unrefreshed qualification; assess visual relevance from the final change.
A deterministic complete-mode nonzero-exit control emits an allowed hit before failing and verifies typed failure plus that partial hit independently of the existing startup-timed fixture.
